image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), resting on green vegetation. The wings are held open but slightly angled, displaying a uniform dark brown color with distinct small eyespots (ocelli) featuring white centers and orange/yellow rings. The body is fuzzy and dark brown. Antennae are visible and appear clubbed. The background consists of blurred green leaves and stems.
